decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize powerful card selection and mana acceleration to quickly assemble a winning combo using Doomsday. The deck aims to efficiently draw into and play Doomsday while protecting the combo with disruption cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize. Thassa's Oracle is the win condition of choice once the combo is set up, allowing the player to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes supplementary cards like Grief and Consider to disrupt the opponent's game plan and further improve consistency in executing the combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo using Doomsday to set up a winning sequence of cards, typically including Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes various cantrips, tutors, and disruption spells to find and protect the combo pieces while disrupting opponents. The deck aims to quickly dig through the deck, set up the perfect pile with Doomsday, and win the game in a single turn. It requires careful planning and sequencing to execute the combo effectively while managing resources and navigating opposing disruption.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo using artifact cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Mox Opal, and Urza's Bauble to generate mana and card advantage. The deck aims to protect its combo pieces with cards like Defense Grid and Containment Construct while utilizing cards like Gamble and Breakthrough to find key pieces. Once the combo is assembled, the deck can close out the game with cards like Grapeshot and Ox of Agonas. The deck also utilizes cards like Echo of Eons and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and control the flow of the game.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with creatures like White Plume Adventurer, Elite Spellbinder, and Palace Jailer to control the board and deal damage quickly. It takes advantage of powerful mana acceleration cards like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors to cast threats ahead of schedule. The deck also has disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down opponents' game plans. Overall, the goal is to quickly establish a strong board presence and maintain pressure on the opponent to secure a victory.

This Reanimator combo deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with big creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, then bringing them back to the battlefield with spells such as Reanimate and Animate Dead. Unmask and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's plans, while Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal accelerate the deck's game plan. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves as an alternate win condition, providing additional value by taxing the opponent's resources. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently put powerful creatures into play from the graveyard. The deck utilizes cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Exhume to bring back creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own combo. It uses fast mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to quickly set up the graveyard and execute its reanimation strategy. Overall, the key concept is to cheat powerful creatures into play for a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play out low-cost spells and creatures to control the tempo of the game and apply pressure to the opponent. By utilizing efficient mana sources and disruptive cards like Daze and Force of Will, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence. Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent serve as aggressive threats that can close out the game quickly if left unchecked. The deck aims to constantly apply pressure, disrupt the opponent's plays, and maintain control of the game tempo.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing an aggressive board presence with efficient threats like Noble Hierarch, Stoneforge Mystic, and True-Name Nemesis while disrupting the opponent's plans with cards like Stifle and Force of Will. The deck also has access to powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. Additionally, it has a solid mana base with dual lands and can generate card advantage with Brainstorm and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The deck's goal is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game until it secures a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures and disrupting opponents with cards like Palace Jailer and Elite Spellbinder. It aims to control the board early on and keep up pressure with aggressive plays. The deck also includes ways to protect key creatures with cards like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire. With a strong mana base and access to efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent by utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board and keep the opponent on the back foot. This deck focuses on tempo plays, disrupting the opponent's game plan while developing a threatening board presence with creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By leveraging counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and close out the game quickly with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play artifacts, using them to generate card advantage and board presence. By combining various powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga, Mox Opal, and Chalice of the Void with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Pithing Needle. The deck also benefits from synergies with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thought Monitor to dig for key pieces and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck is focused on quickly playing out aggressive threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. By efficiently utilizing low cost spells and tempo plays, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game. Key cards include Delver of Secrets for early pressure, Murktide Regent for a powerful late-game threat, and a suite of counterspells and removal spells to protect and support the aggressive game plan. The deck's focus on speed and disruption allows for quick victories and punishing opponents who stumble in their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor and recur combo pieces, as well as disruptive spells like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to protect the combo. The deck can generate mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, and also has removal and additional win conditions through cards like Lightning Bolt and Fury. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble the combo and control the game until victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library in one turn. It also includes support cards like Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Karn, the Great Creator to find and protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Lightning Bolt, Pyroblast, and hate cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Ethersworn Canonist. The main goal is to efficiently and quickly set up the combo while controlling the board and protecting the win condition.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to control the tempo of the game through the use of efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and True-Name Nemesis, disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, and burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining control over the board with countermagic and removal spells like Pyroblast. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower offers additional threats and versatility, allowing the player to adapt to different situations and outmaneuver their opponent.

This deck focuses on the strategy of putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard quickly and efficiently. It utilizes cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to bring back creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Serra's Emissary. The combo aspect of the deck involves using cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to help accelerate the graveyard-based strategy. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key concept is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.
